review.appReviewNotes:
Paste this text into App Store Connect > App Review Information > Notes.

DISTRIBUTION AND AUDIENCE
AliStore POS is a limited employee resource for AliStore cashiers and is intended for Unlisted App distribution. It supports AliStore catalog lookup, sale preparation, shift status, server-issued receipts and till-operation history. It is not offered as a public multi-tenant subscription service and has no public self-service registration.

DEMO ACCOUNT
Use the username and matching credential entered in the Demo Account fields. Enter them exactly in the two Russian-labelled fields on the sign-in screen, then tap the sign-in button. The review path has no SMS or one-time-code step. The account must be active and two-factor authentication must be disabled before resubmission. No credential is included in these notes or in repository metadata.

REVIEW DATA
The owner must verify successful sign-in, a review catalog and the required shift state immediately before resubmission. These notes do not claim that a shift, catalog state or sale record has been seeded until that gate passes.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Access is role-based and authorized by the AliStore server. External receipt printers and payment terminals are separate deployment dependencies; these notes do not claim completed physical-hardware certification. The app does not track users and its privacy manifest declares NSPrivacyTracking=false.

UNLISTED REQUEST
An Unlisted App distribution request must be submitted for this app. Please evaluate this submission for that limited employee audience rather than for public App Store discovery.

CONTACT
Support: https://ali.kg/support.

Кассир магазина находит товары, формирует продажу, готовит раздельную оплату, получает чек с сервера, контролирует состояние смены и просматривает историю операций. Доступ ролевой: магазин выдаёт учётные записи своим кассирам.
